package.description: Get your thoughts, musings and 3am brainwaves onto the page. Then join them up in any way you like.

en-US.description: Get your thoughts, musings and 3am brainwaves onto the page. Then join them up in any way you like.
en-US.longDescription: Scapple is an easy-to-use tool for getting ideas down as quickly as possible and making connections between them. It’s the software equivalent of taking a large piece of paper and writing your thoughts and ideas all over it, in no particular order, perhaps clustering related notes and drawing lines and arrows between them as connections become apparent.
en-US.name: Scapple

zh-CN.description: 把你的想法、沉思和凌晨三点的灵感火花写在纸上，然后以任何你喜欢的方式将它们连接起来。
zh-CN.longDescription: Scapple 是一款易于使用的工具，可帮助您尽可能快速地记录想法，并在它们之间建立联系。它相当于使用一张大纸，随意写下您的思考和想法，无需遵循特定顺序，可以将相关的笔记归类聚集，并在它们之间画出线条或箭头，以体现逐渐显现的关联。
